# freellmpool

This working checkout contains the maintained free gateway rewrite. Use the
local README and integrations/setup/README.md: run freellmpool setup, then
opencode-free or hermes-free. T3 uses the configured OpenCode adapter with
freellmpool/auto. The authenticated endpoint is http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1;
its private gateway key is ~/.config/freellmpool/proxy.key.

Reviewed provider policy excludes retired Aion and ModelScope routes.
freellmpool status reports admitted
routes and exclusions; freellmpool update refreshes catalogs without inference;
freellmpool verify performs bounded synthetic checks through the same free gate
and transactional allowance ledger. Unknown limits are not unlimited capacity.
Paid/trial access is excluded from the default free pool. The public daily
maintenance workflow uses no credentials or inference.

The remaining release and integration links are historical 0.13.0 compatibility
references. Their keyless quickstart and print-only profiles do not establish
the managed setup or contain every helper/fallback inference path.

## Historical upstream release status
- Upstream 0.13 compatibility release: 0.13.0. GitHub and PyPI include the audited provider catalog,
  bounded streaming and sentinel hardening, the Hermes profile, `spread` routing,
  `/livez`, `/readyz`, `/v1/providers`, `/v1/models?ready=true`, and OpenCode
  registry-readiness hardening.
- OpenCode npm registry publication is pending; `opencode-freellmpool` and
  `opencode-freellmpool-tui` were not published as of 2026-08-29.

## Docs
- [Maintained README](https://github.com/pauljones0/freellmpool_sandbox/blob/main/README.md): source installation, reviewed free routing, setup and operations.
- [Maintenance](https://github.com/pauljones0/freellmpool_sandbox/blob/main/docs/maintenance.md): current baseline migration and public status probe contracts.

The upstream repository links below retain historical compatibility references.
- [README](https://github.com/0xzr/freellmpool/blob/main/README.md): install, CLI, library, proxy, MCP, provider keys, routing.
- [Landing page / FAQ](https://pauljones0.github.io/freellmpool_sandbox/): what it is, how it compares, frequently asked questions.
- [Capacity & provider health](https://github.com/0xzr/freellmpool/blob/main/docs/CAPACITY.md): capacity status, health checks, key inventory, external catalog. Guide: https://pauljones0.github.io/freellmpool_sandbox/capacity-management.html
- [Local runtimes](https://github.com/0xzr/freellmpool/blob/main/README.md#local-runtimes-explicit-pin-only): explicitly preview fixed literal-loopback runtimes, affirmatively import pin-only routes, and remove managed imports without credentials or network scanning.
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/0xzr/freellmpool/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): release history.
- [Integrations](https://github.com/0xzr/freellmpool/blob/main/docs/INTEGRATIONS.md): OpenCode, Hermes, metaswarm review adapter, aider, Continue, Cline, Cursor, Open WebUI, LangChain, LlamaIndex, and more.
- [Run OpenCode on free models](https://pauljones0.github.io/freellmpool_sandbox/run-opencode-on-free-models.html): OpenCode setup with an embedded TUI dashboard, long-run agent routing (`freellmpool/agent`), raised stream timeouts, and usage tools.
- [MCP server](https://github.com/0xzr/freellmpool/blob/main/docs/MCP.md): use free models from Claude Desktop/Code/Cursor.
- [Frontier model source audit (2026-07-28)](https://github.com/0xzr/freellmpool/blob/main/docs/FRONTIER_MODEL_SOURCE_AUDIT_2026-07-28.md): 207 public immutable Git blob objects plus current first-party model/runtime sources checked before catalogue and agent-routing changes.

## Historical upstream installation
The maintained fork is installed from source as described in its README; the
PyPI package belongs to upstream.
- Upstream PyPI: `pip install freellmpool` (https://pypi.org/project/freellmpool/)
